item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Your notes are empty, so start with what's true: medication works when it's consistent and honestly tracked. Today, check whether your routine is steady. Are doses on time, and have you noticed any side effects or missed doses? Write those observations down plainly, without judging yourself. Bring them to your next prescriber conversation. Your action: write down today's dose time and any effect you notice.
